tasks.title: Science block: 0.5/s red + 0.5/s green + 6 labs, automated
tasks.detail: Stamp red-science-5, green-science-6, lab-row-6 near the existing labs [gps=-22,-37] (zone it first, keep clear of the depot). Feed from the depot at [gps=-12,-29] (iron 1600, copper 1200, gears 400, circuits 400, asm1 x20, inserters x100) with chest->inserter->belt or a gear-circuit-block, so the labs run without hand feeding. Done = production shows ~30/min red AND green consumed by labs.

tasks.title: Plate belt into circuit block: iron + copper lanes to [gps=14,-44]

It needs one belt entering from the west at tile (14,-44), iron plates on one lane and copper on the other, about 2.7 iron/s and 1 copper/s. After that, the next ask is a steel column (iron plates in) giving ~0.25 steel/s into a chest near [gps=15,-68] for the engine assemblers.
